answer_1.quote: Building on the social scenarios generated by MATRIX, we present MATRIX-Gen, a flexible scenario-driven instruction generator that can generate highly realistic instruction data for various domains.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate models on various benchmarks, including MMLU , IFEval , GSM8K , MATH , MATH-500 (Lightman et al.), HumanEval , MBPP , GPQA Diamond and AIME (MAA, 2024) by measuring pass@1 accuracy.

answer_3.quote: We use the Llama-3-8B-Instruct model to assess the quality of instructions in MATRIX-Gen-SFT and MATRIX-Gen-DPO, categorizing them as very poor, poor, average, good, and excellent.
